from.place: Proof, final sentence: 'Every finite etale $Y_0$-scheme is the restriction of a finite etale $Y$-scheme, the lifting input of the henselian-pair proper-base-change package'; within it, the two changes of basis of Stacks 00MT (normalising the unit entry of a differential to 1 and clearing its column), used in the cancellation of unit entries that makes the bounded finite free resolution of the residue field minimal

title: A triangular change of basis with unit diagonal is a change of basis
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $m\ge0$, and let $F$ be a free $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-free-module] with basis $b_1,\dots,b_m$. Let $v_1,\dots,v_m\in F$ and write $v_k=\sum_{l=1}^m t_{kl}b_l$ with $t_{kl}\in R$. Suppose that either $t_{kl}=0$ whenever $l<k$, or $t_{kl}=0$ whenever $l>k$, and that every diagonal coefficient $t_{kk}$ ($1\le k\le m$) is a unit of $R$. Then $v_1,\dots,v_m$ is a basis of $F$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00MT (lemma-add-trivial-complex), proof lines 24630--24641: the two changes of basis 'after a change of basis of $R^{n_i}$ and $R^{n_{i-1}}$' and '$e'_j=e_j-a_{j1}e_1$ for $j>1$', used there without proof that the new families are bases

mathlib_candidate.how: Not a leaf: is_basis_iff_det (Determinant.lean:634, read with sed -n 625,645p) reduces the claim to IsUnit (e.det v); det_apply (Determinant.lean:616) identifies e.det v with the determinant of the coordinate matrix e.toMatrix v, which is the transpose of (t_kl); det_of_isUpperTriangular / det_of_isLowerTriangular (Block.lean:336, 343, read with sed -n 330,345p) give the product of the diagonal t_kk, a unit. Four declarations composed, plus the orientation of the triangularity under transpose.
